games.name: Orangutag! 🦧
games.desc:
We are working on a new game called "Monke Tag" which will be the sequel to Orangutag.

FAQ:
Q: Will Orangutag still be updated?
A: Only for bug updates, but no new content updates.

Q: When will Monke Tag be released?
A: We have no release date as of now. If we do we will update this page to let you know :) For now we're still developing the game.

Q: Will Monke Tag be different than Orangutag?
A: Yes, so far they are absolutely nothing alike and Monke Tag will have more unique features.

Q: What can I expect from Monke Tag?
A: You can expect things like an Item Shop, Accessories, Game Modes, and we plan on adding much more!
(When we say "Accessories" we're not talking about Avatar/Roblox Accessories)
